name: b(l)ackhome Boutique
beschreibung: The b(l)ackhome Boutique is a hotel in the province of Tyrol. The accommodation distinguishes itself with a modern, distinctive design concept. Guests can choose from various stylishly appointed room categories. The hotel provides appealing amenities including a wellness area and dining options. Its location in Tyrol offers excellent opportunities for excursions into the surrounding mountains and valleys. The property emphasizes a personalized and relaxed atmosphere, catering to travelers who appreciate aesthetic and design-led accommodations. The concept seamlessly combines comfort with regional touches.
